road.name: Road to 6 Stars
road._name_note: Sydney is the 7th World Major but does NOT count toward the Six Star medal (only the original six do). Consider 'Road to the Majors'. Niqui decides; change it here and every script follows.
pinned_questions: What race is on YOUR bucket list, and what's standing between you and the start line?
Be honest: what's the hardest kilometre you've ever run? Tell me where it was.
Are you training for something right now? Drop the race and the date and I'll pray for your build.

faith.name: Faith in Motion
pinned_questions: Which verse carries YOU when a run (or a week) gets hard? I'd love to read them all.
What's one thing you're asking God to help you let go of this season?
Do you pray while you run, or does running feel like prayer? Tell me how it works for you.

_peaks_note: These peaks come from the OLD (mostly immigration, many Nigeria-based) audience. Re-check 'When your viewers are on YouTube' in Studio after ~6 new-niche videos.
